title: Storyteller: Building Multi-modal Apps with TS & ModelFusion - Lars Grammel, PhD
talk_summary: Lars Grammel demos Storyteller, a TypeScript/React + Fastify app that turns a spoken topic into a ~2-minute narrated kids' audio story using ModelFusion as an orchestration layer over Whisper, GPT-3.5/4, Stable Diffusion, and ElevenLabs. The core engineering lesson is latency hiding: stream partial structured LLM output, parse it incrementally, and fan out dependent subtasks in parallel so the user can consume results while generation continues.

takeaways.technique: Stream structured output and act on completed fragments
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of waiting ~90s for a full GPT-4 story structure, they stream it, partially parse with ModelFusion, and narrate each story part as soon as it is complete.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the key idea is streaming the structure ... we need to always part pass the structure and then determine if there is a new passage that we can actually uh narrate
takeaways.numbers: full audio story generation took 1.5 minutes, deemed 'unacceptably long'

takeaways.technique: Parallel fan-out after a cheap planning step
takeaways.what_they_do: After a fast GPT-3.5 outline (~4s), title, image, and audio generation all run in parallel; only the slow GPT-4 audio step is streamed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: once we have that we can start a bunch of other tasks in parallel generating the title generating the image and generating and narrating the audio story

takeaways.technique: Pick model per subtask by latency, not just capability
takeaways.what_they_do: They deliberately use GPT-3.5-turbo-instruct for outline/title because it is fast, and reserve GPT-4 low-temperature for the quality-critical story extension.
takeaways.evidence_quote: models are being chosen such that the processing time for like the generation say the story is minimized

takeaways.technique: Two-stage prompt: extract keywords, then generate
takeaways.what_they_do: They pass the whole story into a GPT-4 prompt that extracts representative keywords, then feed only those keywords to Stable Diffusion, improving consistency.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we pass in the whole story into a gp4 prompt that then extracts relevant representative keywords for an image prompt from the story

takeaways.what_they_do: Pre-embed voice descriptions, then retrieve candidate voices filtered by gender and enforce uniqueness across speakers.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we beforehand embedded all the voices based on their descriptions and now can just retrieve them filtered by gender
